Ladies “Fashion Cup”- Test 1. Open Wave MH (Only by the OMC official sponsors) The competitors must present their mannequin heads' hair straight open and brushed back before lineup in the village holding area. Mirror numbers will be distributed in the holding area. One (1) of the OMC Competition Director will direct the concerned competitors to their m irror number. The competitors have 5 minutes to set up all their tools. The General Commissioner will call all competitors to wait on the red carpet. The Competition Directors will check the rules. If the hair is not brushed straight and back, then the Competiti on Directors will do it. The General Commissioner will start the competition. In Subject: The hairstyle must reflect the images of the OMC Inspirations of the concerned year. Layers: Are optional. The minimum layers length must be 10 cm, except in the bang area. Hair Extensions: Are allowed to add volume and texture, the hair extensions must be inserted in the head before the test. The hair must be strait not prepared in advance. Hair Color: The hair colors must be harmoniously integrated. Allowed: white, black, brown, blond, purple, pink, orange, silver, red. All other colors are forbidden. Styling Tools: All allowed. Hair Style: 100% of the Hair Style must be styled down. Time: 35 minutes. Score: Maximum 30 points / Minimum 24 points. x. Off Subject: Onsite – Online x. Online: must upload 4 photos, 1 frontal image also showing the top area, 1 side image, 1 back image showing the hair style. The 4th photo shows the official M. H. sponsor’s name. x. Forbidden: to create updo hair styles. x. Forbidden: to cover both eyes of the model. x. Forbidden: use of ornaments. x. Forbidden: complete body mannequins. x. Penalty Points: 10. per infraction
